subject: Hosted API onramp: connectivity & rateguard recap
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Zhao <alex@cleverpay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Dec 2028 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API onramp: connectivity & rateguard recap

Alex — great to meet earlier. Thanks for the demo time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

1) What we heard from CleverPay
- Primary interest: hosted API for fastest time-to-market. Critical path: payments fraud scoring workflow with ~peak 50 req/s per endpoint, mostly short prompts (~150 tokens).
- Compliance note: ingesting limited PII (email + device fingerprint) — you indicated SOC2 and audit logs will be required for procurement.
- Preference to start with hosted trial, then evaluate Dedicated if throughput/cost favors it.

2) Our proposal (next steps)
- Sandbox access: we’ll provision a sandbox org + ephemeral API keys for your devs (endpoint + streaming).
- Rate profile: initial sandbox cap 60 req/s with token/time quotas; we’ll map to production ratebands during pilot.
- Quickstart pack: I attached our hosted quickstart checklist and an ops playbook for connectivity/egress requirements.
- Security artifacts: we’ll share SOC2 summary and an evidence list for procurement; Priyom will own the questionnaire back-and-forth.

3) Asks from your side
- Confirm the expected 95th-percentile concurrency and whether 50 req/s is per endpoint or aggregated across endpoints.
- Procurement lead and target timeline for contract review (DocuSign link preferred).

Proposed timeline: sandbox access within 3 business days once we get the procurement contact; two-week pilot with a follow-up readout.

I’ll schedule a short ops kickoff once you confirm the procurement contact.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf
From: Alex Zhao <alex@cleverpay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cleverpay.com
Date: Mon, 11 Dec 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API onramp: connectivity & rateguard recap

Thanks, Logan — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 50 req/s estimate is aggregated for the scoring service (so across two endpoints it could peak ~50 total). Bursts from campaign windows could push short spikes to ~120 req/s for <60s; how do you typically handle short burst behavior on hosted?
- Procurement: looping in procurement@cleverpay.com (Sam Lee). They prefer an initial vendor questionnaire + our security checklist filled. I’ll attach the procurement questionnaire in a follow-up.
- Compliance: we need confirmation that logs/audit trails for user activity are retained for 13 months and accessible for export. Is that possible on hosted or would that push us to Dedicated/Private?

On timelines: aim to have sandbox creds this week if possible. We’re targeting a pilot kickoff next Tue (19 Dec) if procurement can move quickly.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Zhao
Head of Integrations, CleverPay

On Mon, Dec 11, 2028 at 15:22 Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — great to meet earlier. Thanks for the demo time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: ...
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Zhao <alex@cleverpay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, procurement@cleverpay.com
Date: Tue, 12 Dec 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API onramp: connectivity & rateguard recap

Appreciate the quick reply, Alex — answers inline and updated asks below.

- Bursts: Hosted supports short burst capacity via our burst queueing policy and soft-burst allowance. For spikes ~120 req/s under 60s we recommend enabling burst capacity in the sandbox; we’ll also add a circuit-breaker policy so user-facing latency stays bounded. We’ll surface the exact throttling headers in responses so you can instrument backoff.

- Logs & retention: Hosted retains request-level audit logs and tracing for 13 months in the paid pilot (we can surface exports). For customers requiring customer-managed retention or HSM-level keys we typically recommend Private; Dedicated can also offer extended retention with dedicated storage. For procurement — we’ll provide a SOC2 summary and a short doc that maps retention options to deployment modes.

- Sandbox access: provisioning in progress — I attached the quickstart checklist and your procurement questionnaire (from procurement@cleverpay.com) backfilled where we could. Please confirm one procurement contact and an NDA if you need one — linking a DocuSign NDA here: https://docusign.com/na01/doc/ABC123-cleverpay-nda

Next steps (action owners):
- CleverPay: confirm procurement lead and preferred signature flow (Sam/procurement@cleverpay.com) — Alex
- Redwood: provision sandbox keys & enable soft-burst (Logan/Vanessa)
- Redwood security: share SOC2 summary and retention mapping doc (Priyom)

I’ll set a 30-minute ops kickoff for Wed; if that doesn’t work we can move to early next week.

Thanks again — looking forward to the pilot.

— Logan
attachments: hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf, cleverpay-procurement-questionnaire.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Zhao <alex@cleverpay.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, procurement@cleverpay.com
Date: Wed, 13 Dec 2028 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API onramp: connectivity & rateguard recap

Quick note from ops: sandbox will be provisioned with the following defaults unless you ask for changes:
- Sandbox ratecap: 60 req/s aggregate, soft-burst to 150 req/s for <60s (observability only, not billed).
- Endpoints: /v1/score (sync), /v1/score-stream (streaming).
- Response headers: X-Rate-Limit-Limit / X-Rate-Limit-Remaining / X-Rate-Limit-Reset and a Retry-After on 429.

If you want different burst windows or token quotas, tell us which endpoint should get priority. I’ll also add a short runbook to the sandbox org that explains how to read the throttling headers.

— Vanessa
Engineering Ops | Redwood Inference
